subject: Quick 30m: Review your usage spike & next steps

Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 30m: Review your usage spike & next steps

Hi Priya,

I noticed NovusLens just crossed a usage spike yesterday (roughly 1.1M tokens across inference calls) — congrats on the early momentum. I wanted to offer a quick 30-minute call to:

- Walk through the traffic patterns we saw
- Recommend batching/caching tweaks to reduce token cost
- Review simple scaling and failure-handling options if you want predictable SLOs

Suggested times (PDT):
- Tue 8/18 10:00–10:30
- Tue 8/18 15:00–15:30
- Wed 8/19 09:00–09:30

Attached is a short mutual action plan (draft) that we can use to capture owners and next steps.

If none of those work, tell me a couple windows and I’ll send a calendar invite. Who from your side should join? 

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

Attachments: NovusLens-MAP-draft.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

1) 5m — quick intros & goals
